description:
🍋 Key Lime Pie Ice Cream Recipe (Better Than Häagen-Dazs!) | Homemade Ice Cream 🍨

This creamy, zesty key lime pie ice cream is rich, tangy, and packed with chunks of real graham cracker crust – and yes, it’s better than Häagen-Dazs. Thisn recipe is the perfect balance of citrus, cream, and crunch. If you love the tropical punch of lime and the smooth indulgence of premium ice cream, you’re going to want to make this today.

The extract used in this video: https://tinyurl.com/utz963mx USA & Canada
The next extract to try: https://tinyurl.com/4nrt6muh USA & Canada
UK: https://tinyurl.com/msy3def9
Both avaiable in the US and Canada, UK link for equivalent. 

🧁 INGREDIENTS
Milk 415g (1.5 cups + 2tbsp)
Cream 370g (1.25 cups + 3tbsp)
Sugar 130g (0.5 cups +2 tbsp)
Corn syrup 30g (2 tbsp)
SMP 60g (4 tbsp)
Stabilizer 2g OPTIONAL (0.5tsp)
Key Lime Extract 5-7g (1-1.5tsp)

📍 CHAPTERS / TIME STAMPS
00:00 - Intro: Why This Recipe
01:21 - Ingredients
04:05 - The Key ime Extract bit
04:57 - Graham Craker Crumble
07:26 - The Meringue making me work 
11:49 - Churn and add ins
12:19 - The Scoop Test: Texture Reveal
13:27 - Outro and rambling

💡 PRO TIPS
 • Careful if using lime juice, it will curdle SUPER easily
 • Don’t skip the meringue – it’s the magic that makes this taste like pie.
 • Use a bloody stand mixer for the meringue!!!

📌 KEYWORDS & TAGS
